name: minimal-background
description: Launch, sit in the foreground long enough to clear the stats upload debounce, then background via HOME and watch what the SDK does.

steps.why: stats.minimum_upload_interval_ms is 30s and the startup upload arms it. Backgrounding sooner means the ON_STOP upload is debounced and never attempted, so the run measures the debounce instead of the thing you asked about.
long enough to see the ~5s background network cutoff, the upload ack (475ms-17s observed), and at least one ~30s timed flush
